page.notes: Printed text runs to the foot of the scan, and the last word is completed on the final line as "siqui-dem", so it is set as one word with its printed hyphen. The reading "Cænæ" is uncertain, as the ligature is faint. The line "Cænæ" has been kept as printed with the ligatures, and the transcription of "pænitentiæ" and "Cænæ" relies on the ligatures being æ. Stains, a faint dot at the top right and marks at the left edge are not printed text and were left out. Printed spelling is kept throughout, including "dixisse" and "Remissam" as printed.
